name: Pricing with an effect border
for: A pricing section of two to four plans: the recommended plan gets a thin border of the effect and a faint wash of it behind its name and price; the others stay plain.
how: One still effect host behind the plan, 1px outside it, masked to a 1.5px ring (content box cut out of the border box) plus a 20% wash fading down over 150px.
rules: Only the one recommended plan carries the effect.
Its call to action is the only primary button in the row.
The wash stays under 20% where text sits.
Still (speed 0): a pricing card carries no pause button, so nothing in it loops.
a11y: Plans are articles with headings, prices in text and real links; the badge describes the featured plan. Without WebGL the featured plan keeps a solid accent border. The effect is still.
